text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...What's wrong?! What's wrong is... gh! 
Everyone's... celebrating my birthday...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Every time, I tried so hard to show how 
grateful I was with all my might... that I 
completely ran out of breath...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whaaat?! In that case, should I not say 
happy birthday?!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: That would just... feel so lonely...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Wait until tomorrow, please...! 
I'll... I'll make sure to get better by 
tomorrow...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I-I got it! I'll celebrate your birthday 
tomorrow, okay!
